direction_vectors: Fixed per point; see points[*].directions. D001 preserves the preview optical-axis approach.

coordinate_convention.B: UR controller Base; base_link rotated +pi around local Z
coordinate_convention.C: OpenCV: +X image right, +Y image down, +Z forward
coordinate_convention.M: ChArUco top-left; +X right, +Y down, +Z into board
coordinate_convention.marker_center: Printed pattern center, same axes as M
coordinate_convention.direction: Base-axis motion direction d; start = target - distance*d
coordinate_convention.pixel: Scene projection coordinates; centred principal point (width/2, height/2)

sampling.selection: Farthest viewpoint selection using position and rotation; tilt bin quotas 4/6/8/12
sampling.direction_distribution: 20 directions on a deterministic sphere in each fixed camera frame: D001=+Z, D020=-Z, 18 golden-angle intermediate directions

camera.lens_reference: HIKROBOT MVL-MF1228M-8MP (exterior reference; user's lens model unknown)
camera.model_note: Dimension-based exterior, ideal pinhole optics, no distortion or measured hardware calibration.

sources.camera_source_note: HIKROBOT original datasheet, mirrored by EQ Vision

checks: Nominal FK/IK and full-white-plate projection; downstream Blender occlusion and geometry checks required

range_summary.range_note: Finite candidate screening; no claim of globally maximal workspace or collision-free physical motion
